pairs: Erat autem dives valde in possessione auri et argenti.
But he was very wealthy by the possession of gold and silver.
And he returned by the way that he came,
all the way to the place where before he had pitched his tent,
usque ad locum ubi prius fixerat tabernaculum inter Bethel et Hai,
in loco altaris quod fecerat prius:
There, at the place of the altar he had made before,
he again called upon the name of the Lord.
et Lot qui erat cum Abram,
Neither was the land able to contain them,
so that they might dwell together.
their substance was so great that they could not live in common.
Unde et facta est rixa inter pastores gregum Abram et Lot.
And then there also arose a conflict between the shepherds of Abram and of Lot.
Eo autem tempore Chananæus et Pherezæus habitabant in terra illa.
Now at that time the Canaanite and the Perizzite lived in that land.
Ne quæso sit jurgium inter me
let there be no quarrel between me and you,
and between my shepherds and your shepherds.
Ecce universa terra coram te est:
Behold, the entire land is before your eyes.
If you will go to the left,
I will pass to the left.”
And so Lot, lifting up his eyes,
saw all the region around the Jordan,
quæ universa irrigabatur antequam subverteret Dominus Sodomam et Gomorrham,
which was thoroughly irrigated, before the Lord overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
It was like the Paradise of the Lord,
et sicut Ægyptus venientibus in Segor.
and it was like Egypt, approaching toward Zoar.
Elegitque sibi Lot regionem circa Jordanem,
And Lot chose for himself the region around the Jordan,
and he withdrew by way of the east.
divisique sunt alterutrum a fratre suo.
And they were divided, one brother from the other.
Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan.
Lot vero moratus est in oppidis,
Lot stayed in the towns that were around the Jordan,
But the men of Sodom were very wicked,
and they were sinners before the Lord beyond measure.
And the Lord said to Abram,
postquam divisus est ab eo Lot:
after Lot was divided from him:
Leva oculos tuos et vide a loco,
and gaze out from the place where you are now,
to the north and to the meridian,
to the east and to the west.
All the land that you see,
tibi dabo, et semini tuo usque in sempiternum.
I will give to you, and to your offspring even forever.
Faciamque semen tuum sicut pulverem terræ:
And I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth.
si quis potest hominum numerare pulverem terræ,
If any man is able to number the dust of the earth,
he will be able to number your offspring as well.
Arise and walk through the land in its length,
et perambula terram in longitudine et in latitudine sua:
For I will give it to you.”
Abram went and dwelt by the steep valley of Mamre,
And he built an altar there to the Lord.
